import numpy as np

def ddim_sampling(model, num_steps, alpha_bar, img_shape):
    T = len(alpha_bar)
    steps = np.linspace(0, T - 1, num_steps, dtype=int)[::-1]
    x = np.random.randn(*img_shape)
    for i, t in enumerate(steps):
        eps = model(x, t)
        ab = alpha_bar[t]
        ab_prev = alpha_bar[steps[i + 1]] if i + 1 < len(steps) else alpha_bar[0]
        x = np.sqrt(ab_prev) * (x - np.sqrt(1 - ab) * eps) / np.sqrt(ab) + np.sqrt(1 - ab_prev) * eps
    return x
